text:
alex: Heads up — us-west-2 GPU fabric is degrading fast. ~30% node loss in the last 5m. I'm going to apply emergency per-customer soft caps and start shifting non-enterprise traffic to us-east-1. Need quick ack and someone to own status page updates. ops-bot already opened INC-17820.

ops-bot: [ALERT] GPUCluster us-west-2 node-failure trend >25% - incident INC-17820 created. Pager: jess

maria: Ack. Which command are you running to apply caps?

alex: Running the orchestration policy now. Command:
```
rctl apply-policy --policy emergency-throttle-2026 --scope customer --selector heavy_usage --limit 400rps --mode soft
```
This will soft-cap heavy customers, whitelist enterprise/dedicated.

deploy-bot: policy emergency-throttle-2026 started rollout -> 37 targets. staged rollout: 10% -> 50% -> 100% (30s intervals).

dina: Please ensure dedicated/enterprise pools are exempt. We should not throttle paid reserved capacity. Also prep billing ops — customers getting caps may want credits.

jitender: Cost note: cross-region reroute will increase egress. Quick estimate: ~ $2.1k extra if we sustain a 20% reroute for 2 hours. We should limit reroute to stateless endpoints only.

alex: Plan spelled out: 1) soft cap free tier -> 60% of normal throughput, 2) standard paid -> 75%, 3) whitelist enterprise/dedicated, 4) start 20% traffic reroute of stateless generation to us-east-1 for load relief, 5) monitor for cache-miss-induced token regen.

hao: I'll flip the route rules. Note: KV cache miss rate will spike — expect 150-250ms tail increase for rerouted requests. Also prepping `prefix_cache` warmers to reduce regen.

maria: I'll update statuspage: "Degraded capacity in us-west-2. Temporary throttles applied to high-traffic accounts. Working on cross-region reroute. ETA 1-2h." @support please push canned responses for affected customers. :loudspeaker:

jess: On pager. Watching logs and node replacements. If we see further node churn (>=10% more), we escalate to full failover. Also coordinating with cloud provider for fabric health.

deploy-bot: rollout step complete -> 50% (18 targets). Applying whitelist rules.

alex: Early indicators look promising — token burn rate down ~22% vs peak. Keep an eye on queued latency. If we do not drop below 70% util within 15m, we trigger extra preemption and increase reroute to 35%.

jitender: Re: credits, recommend offering pro-rated credits for impacted paid customers with >5% error or >300ms sustained tail increase. Ops finance notified.

maria: Drafted support note and status update, pushing now. Will tag customers flagged in the throttle list for manual outreach.

dina: Good. After stabilizing, let's run a post-incident review focusing on placement strategy and burst capacity economics.

alex: Thanks everyone. Keep threads here for updates. :thumbsup:
